executive_summary: Riya runs Mehta Organics, selling cold-pressed oils online at about 400 orders a month, with one part-time team member (Arjun). Her evenings go on replying to WhatsApp customers and chasing late wholesale payments; three wholesale shops currently owe around ₹1.8 lakh in total. In three months she wants her evenings back, automatic payment reminders, and a clear view of which wholesale customers are worth keeping. She indicated a tentative budget of ₹25-30 thousand a month, pending a conversation with her husband, who handles the finances. Her main concern is automation talking to her customers directly, after a chatbot sent wrong prices last year. Next: the consultant sends a short plan by Monday, and a 45-minute workflow mapping session is proposed for Thursday afternoon next week (time not yet booked).

Hi Riya,

Thanks again for making time for our discovery call. It was really helpful to hear how things are running at Mehta Organics.

Here's what I took away. With around 400 orders a month and a team of you and Arjun, your evenings are going on two things: replying to customers on WhatsApp and chasing wholesale buyers who pay late. Over the next three months, you'd like to:

- get your evenings back
- have payment reminders go out automatically
- know clearly which wholesale customers are worth keeping

I also heard your concern about the chatbot that sent wrong prices to your customers last year, and it's a fair one. So I'd suggest we start with workflows where nothing reaches a customer until you've reviewed and approved it. We'd only give the automation more freedom once you've seen it working reliably and you're comfortable with it.

As promised, I'll send you a short plan by Monday. After that, let's do the 45-minute workflow mapping session next week. You mentioned Thursday afternoon suits you, so please pick a time that works for you here: [CAL.COM BOOKING LINK]

There's no rush on the commercial side. I know you'd like to discuss it internally first, and I'm happy to answer any questions that come up.

Looking forward to it.

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME]
